PARKING AT SUNSET BEACH
A VISITOR’S GUIDE TO PAID PARKING
Park only in marked gravel spaces or marked parking lots designated by
Pay-to-Park signage and concrete curb stops.
Paid Parking hours: 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., April 1 - October 31. Parking
before and after these times is free.
All spaces are paid parking unless otherwise marked (handicap, one hour
free, etc.).
Green curb stops are parking spaces for golf carts only.
Handicap parking is free only in marked handicap spaces. A vehicle with a
handicap placard or license plate parking in a non-handicap space
requires a parking pass.
Be sure to double check your license plate when purchasing a pass to
avoid a typo and citation!
If purchasing a season pass, set up your account before parking for the
first time.
